title: Volunteer-Shift Reliability
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`volunteer:shift`), donations (`donation:gift`), community events (`community:event`), mutual-aid requests (`mutualaid:request`), impact metrics (`impact:metric`).
app: Volunteering and community telemetry — volunteer-hours trackers, donation receipts, mutual-aid request boards, and community-event calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=volunteer:shift
| stats sum(eval(if(status="attended",1,0))) as attended, count as signed_up
| eval reliability_pct=round(100*attended/signed_up,1), missed=signed_up-attended
description: Measures how often you actually show up for the shifts you sign up for.
value: Charities depend on reliable volunteers; an honest attendance rate helps you commit to what you can truly keep.
implementation: Ingest sign-ups and attendance into `index=personal`; compute reliability.
visualization: Single-value panel of shift reliability percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how often you turn up for the volunteering you signed up for, helping you commit only to what you can keep.
